datasets.purpose: IPC Classification spatial data in different IPC scenarios collected by FEWS NET enumerators on a regular schedule (typically monthly).

lineage.description: FEWS NET enumerators collected IPC classification data on a monthly basis throughout 2012 across Uganda, classifying geographic areas into food insecurity phases. The data represents post-assessment impact classifications of populations experiencing acute food insecurity, with temporal snapshots captured in January, April, July, and October 2012.
